tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the Armenly catalog of Armenian music for artists, albums and songs by name. Romanised names work best (e.g. 'Sirusho', 'Aram Asatryan', 'Sari Aghjik'); Armenian script is also matched. Returns ids for the other tools and a playable armenly.com link for each result.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: An Armenian artist's profile, best-known songs, discography (albums, singles, compilations, appearances) and related artists. Accepts a catalog id from search_catalog, or a lowercase hyphenated name such as 'sirusho' or 'aram-asatryan'.

tools.name: get_album
tools.description: An album, single or EP with its full tracklist and other releases by the same artist.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: One song: who performs it, the release it is on, its year and length, and more songs by the same artist.

tools.name: similar_tracks
tools.description: Songs to play after a given song: the same artist, related artists and the same genre, shuffled into a station.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Browse the artist directory, optionally by genre or by style category, sorted by popularity, name or number of songs. Use it to recommend artists in a style.

tools.name: browse_genre
tools.description: Songs and artists in a genre: modern_hits (pop), kef (party and wedding music, rabiz), traditional (folk, ashughakan, duduk, sacred), urban (rap, rock, electronic) or chill. Narrow it with a style category.

tools.name: browse_mood
tools.description: Songs for a mood or occasion. tools.description: Armenian songs from one decade. tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: The most played Armenian songs of all time (top_tracks), the most played released in a given year (best_of_year), the newest albums, singles and EPs (new_releases), or uploads since the catalog was last crawled (fresh_releases).
